mp_core.description: Shared types, model configuration, and runtime primitives for MP tasks.
mp_core.purpose: Models, inputs, result containers, lifecycle, native assets, and web support
mp_core.tasks: Model assets, image and audio containers, result types, errors, and task lifecycle

mp_vision.description: Cross-platform MediaPipe vision tasks for Dart and Flutter.
mp_vision.purpose: The 11 vision tasks in the current MediaPipe Solutions guide, with image, video, and live-stream entry points where applicable
mp_vision.tasks: Image classification and embedding, object and face detection, image and interactive segmentation, gesture recognition, and hand, pose, face, and holistic landmarks

mp_camera.description: Camera frame conversion and scheduling for MP vision tasks in Flutter.
mp_camera.purpose: Flutter camera conversion, orientation metadata, and latest-frame scheduling
mp_camera.tasks: BGRA8888, NV21, and YUV420 frame conversion, rotation resolution, and latest-frame backpressure

mp_text.description: Cross-platform MediaPipe text tasks for Dart and Flutter.
mp_text.purpose: Language detection, classification, embedding, proofreading, and summarization
mp_text.tasks: Language detection, text classification, text embedding, text proofreading, and text summarization

mp_audio.description: Cross-platform MediaPipe audio tasks for Dart and Flutter.
mp_audio.tasks: Audio classification for clips and timestamped frames

mp_genai.description: MediaPipe generative AI APIs for Flutter with Web and Android backends.
mp_genai.purpose: LLM inference, Android function calling, RAG, and image generation
mp_genai.tasks: LLM sessions and streaming; Android function calling, RAG, and diffusion image generation
